modules.title: 7 operational modules, plus AI Copilot (coming soon)
modules.sub: Every plan includes all seven working modules. AI Copilot is a planned additional module, included in your plan when released.

items.title: Business Analysis Module
items.desc: Shows the real net revenue and profit generated by each project. Visualizes top-performing client projects, category margins, and financial health in real time.

items.title: Daftar Overview Module
items.desc: A birds-eye view of your entire daftar's momentum. See live task completion, active projects, employee statuses, and department progress at a single glance.

items.title: Attendance & Leave Module
items.desc: 1-click daily check-in. Tracks attendance, casual/sick leaves, WFH requests, office working hours, late arrivals, and early exits with an immutable audit log.

items.title: Projects Module
items.desc: Organizes all client projects category-wise (e.g. Mobile, Web, AI, Retainers). Track milestone deadlines, deliverables, sprints, and subtasks cleanly.

items.title: Password Manager Module
items.desc: Secure client credentials in an AES-256 encrypted vault instead of Google Sheets or WhatsApp. Grant access strictly to specific individuals with copy/reveal logs.

items.title: Time Tracking Module
items.desc: Developers track billable time via an active timer or manual log entry. Visualize exactly who worked the most on each client task without weekly timesheet friction.

items.title: Workload & Capacity Module
items.desc: Inspect live developer capacity before delegating work. Instantly see who has maximum tasks/projects allocated and who has available bandwidth, preventing burnout and blown deadlines.

ai.title: AI Copilot Module
ai.desc: An assistant that watches your daftar so you don't have to. When released, it will be included in your existing plan at no extra subscription cost. It recommends which team member each new task should be assigned to based on live workload and skills, flags projects trending toward a loss, and summarizes where the week's time actually went.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.sub: Direct answers to the questions agency owners ask us most.

items.a: DaftarHub (Hub دفتر) is an agency operations platform for digital agencies and service providers. It replaces disconnected tools with one system covering attendance, leaves, projects, client passwords, time tracking, workload, and project profitability. Every plan includes seven working core modules plus three custom modules built for your agency.

Small digital agencies, software development agencies, web and mobile development teams, AI and other digital service providers, and any service business that wants structured office and team management. It is built for agencies, not as a generic task manager.

Seven core modules are working today: Business Analysis, Daftar Overview, Attendance & Leave, Projects, Password Manager, Time Tracking, and Workload & Capacity. All seven are included in every plan. AI Copilot is a planned additional core module still in development.

items.q: What are the three custom modules?
items.a: They are three additional modules built specifically for your agency — not three selected from the existing seven. They are designed around your office workflows and operational processes, based on a discovery meeting where we learn how your team works and where time is being spent.

items.q: Does every paying customer receive the three custom modules?
items.a: Yes. Every paying customer receives all seven core modules plus three custom modules built for their agency, included in the plan price. There is no separate charge for the three custom modules.

items.q: How are the custom modules selected?
items.a: After a discovery meeting. We learn your agency's workflow and how time is spent on your existing processes, then you and the DaftarHub team decide together which three modules will make your operations more systematic.

items.q: When will the custom modules be delivered?
items.a: During your first month. Your first week is reserved for onboarding; the three custom modules are agreed with you and delivered across the first month.

items.q: Are small future changes and maintenance included?
items.a: Yes. Small future changes and maintenance are included at no additional charge, along with ongoing support. Customer-reported issues are resolved within two days.

items.q: How are additional new modules charged?
items.a: The initial three custom modules are included for every paying customer. If you request a new module beyond those three, the additional development is charged according to the number of development hours spent.

No. AI Copilot is in development and not yet available as a working module. It is planned as an additional core module and will be included in your existing plan price when released — current prices will not change.

items.q: Are AI API usage costs included in the subscription?
items.a: The subscription covers access to AI Copilot when it is released. AI API usage costs are paid by your agency, not included in the subscription.

Every plan (Starter, Growth, Scale) includes all seven core modules, three custom modules built for your agency, first-week onboarding, ongoing support, free small changes and maintenance, and 2-day issue resolution. The plans differ by seat limit and team size, not by features.

Every employee onboarded into your workspace counts as one user. A 10-user plan lets you onboard 10 people. Within your plan's seat limit there is no separate per-seat charge — that is what "no seat penalties" means here.

items.q: Can employee job titles be customized?
items.a: Yes. Employee job titles are customizable — Developer, Designer, QA Engineer, Tech Lead, Project Manager, HR Manager, or any title your agency uses. If you need additional role or workflow customization, share your requirements and the DaftarHub team will customize the setup for you.

items.q: What happens during the first-week onboarding?
items.a: The first week is dedicated to onboarding. We explain the features, help your team understand how the software works, handle migration and integrations, and get everyone comfortable using the system. Your three custom modules are delivered during the first month, not the first week.

items.q: What support is available after onboarding?
items.a: Ongoing support is included. Small future changes and maintenance are free, customer-reported issues are resolved within two days, and you receive role-specific handbooks for Admin, HR, Employee, Project Manager, and Team Lead.

items.q: What happens to our agency data when we leave?
items.a: When you leave, we export your agency's data as stored so you keep access to it, then delete everything associated with your agency from our systems — projects, teams, employees, logs, and related records.

items.q: How is our data isolated and secured?
items.a: Your agency receives a separate database instance and app deployment. Client passwords are stored in an AES-256 encrypted vault with an immutable audit log recording who viewed or copied credentials and when. Developer salary rates and project margin charts are role-gated and accessible only to designated owners.
